Sets whether BlitzLLVM merges small textures into shared images. It is on by default. A texture is merged when it is loaded from a file with [LoadTexture](LoadTexture), is at most 256 by 256 pixels and is not a sphere or cube map, a render target, a sheet of frames or an sRGB texture. Repeating, mirrored and mip mapped textures are merged as well. Everything that shows merged textures together is then drawn in fewer calls, because it no longer has to change texture between them. The textures look the same, and a merged texture is a texture like any other: it keeps its handle, and the first time a program needs a picture of its own for it ([TextureBuffer](TextureBuffer)) it gets one back.

Textures are merged by the next [RenderWorld](RenderWorld), using the setting it finds then. The environment variable `BLITZ_NO_TEXTURE_ATLAS=1` turns the merging off from the start, and `BLITZ_TEXTURE_ATLAS_MAX` changes the largest size (up to 1022). `BLITZ_TEXTURE_ATLAS_LOG=1` prints on the console what happened to every texture and why.

This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals never merge textures.
@param enabled  True to merge small textures, False to keep every texture as its own image.
